elements.evidence: Section 12.4 binds Customer through the mutual phrase “Neither Party shall solicit.”
The restriction applies to “Neither Party” soliciting the other Party’s personnel.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly limits covered personnel to those “directly involved in the Services.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: The restriction applies “for 12 months after their involvement ends.”

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 states that “General advertisements ... are not restricted.”

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 states that “unsolicited approaches ... are not restricted.”

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly states that “hiring” is not restricted, consistent with Section 12.3’s no-hire disclaimer.
